consume_requests: create a threaded consumer that drains a request iterator and feeds requests into a gRPC handler
blocking_unary_response: block until a unary gRPC response is available from a handler and return the response value
blocking_unary_response_with_call: block for a unary gRPC response and return both the response value and a Call object
future_call: create a FutureCall that wraps a gRPC handler with Future and Call interface methods
ResponseIteratorCall: build an iterable Call object that streams responses from a gRPC handler one at a time
